messages:
ashwin: Heads-up — VelvetPay is hitting intermittent 429s + high tail latency since ~11:30 UTC. Appears their dedicated pool is oscillating (scale up/down every ~3m). Can someone triage?

maria: Saw the alerts, bumped min_replicas 2->4 as a quick mitigation. Still seeing allocation churn and some auth retries.

jack: Pulled autoscaler logs, it's toggling decisions when queue_depth hovers around threshold. Sample: 
```
[11:34:12] autoscaler: metric(queue_depth)=12 -> scale_up(1)
[11:36:05] autoscaler: metric(queue_depth)=3  -> scale_down(1)
[11:39:01] autoscaler: metric(queue_depth)=15 -> scale_up(2)
```

maria: Customer also had a big burst yesterday (~40k small requests). auth errors mixed in (401 AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED then 429s). Could be client retry pattern amplifying.

elena: Posting the p95 latency snapshots to the ticket. Current autoscaler config on their pool: cooldown_seconds=60, scale_window=120s, down_threshold=20% util.

ashwin: Proposal: increase cooldown to 180s, require threshold sustained for 2 windows before scaling, and add a scale_down hysteresis like require util < 25% for 3 windows. Also consider warming KV cache on new replicas to avoid transient latency.

jack: Also saw a routing fallback event where a failed request retried to another replica — might be double-counting queued work. Will trace.

sre-bot: Runbook suggests isolating tenant traffic to confirm noisy neighbor. Repro snippet (lab):
```bash
# repro: synthetic burst to reproduce ping-pong
for i in $(seq 1 2000); do curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood/v1/generate & done
```

maria: Ran a canary from our testbed with 5k parallel connections; reproduced scale ping-pong in ~8m. Looks like autoscaler uses raw queue length without smoothing — spikes cause up decisions then immediate drop causes down.

ops_lead: Customer is on Dedicated contract — treat as P1 for stability. Immediate mitigations: 1) set min_replicas=6 for VelvetPay pool, 2) apply tenant-level rate cap temporarily, 3) enforce a soft-burst policy to spread requests.

support-bot: Updated ticket #43278: customer reports their invoice processing failed during the flaps; also attached sample request IDs.

elena: After setting min_replicas=6 + cooldown=180s we saw the pool stabilize, queue_depth smoothed and 429s dropped — no new 429s in the last 12m. Monitoring continues.

ashwin: Action items: 
- infra PR to broaden default down-cooldown and add EWMA smoothing. owner=jack
- repro harness + lab test harness for tenant bursts. owner=elena
- customer comms + temporary caps. owner=maria
ETA: 24h for full mitigation rollout and postmortem.

jack: Drafting PR: add config params queue_ewma_alpha (default 0.25) and min_stable_windows (default 2). Also propose an option to require scale decisions on consecutive windows.

maria: Customer replied: thanks for the quick fix :heart: — said throughput looks normal now. I'll keep them posted.

ashwin: Keep thread open until postmortem and PR merged. Thanks everyone.
